NOT a string, but a bug the translation EXPOSES and the one thing in this extension I could not fix inside a string swap. The header placeholder is only overwritten when core's own placeholder starts with 'search'. Once core renders in Spanish it is 'Buscar…', the guard fails, and forum.header.placeholder (“Busca — presiona /”) never appears — so the '/' shortcut becomes undiscoverable in exactly the language most readers use. The key is written and wired; widening the condition (match core's .Search-input element rather than its text) is a behaviour change and belongs to whoever owns the header.

checks: gate_search_index_analytics.py — en/es key parity, ICU placeholder parity, plural arms present on both sides, every key the map calls exists, no dead keys, php -l / node --check on every touched file.

icu/render.ts — every ICU string rendered at count 0/1/2/12431 in BOTH en and es-MX, through intl-messageformat (what PHP ext-intl agrees with) AND through RichMessageFormatter constructed exactly as Flarum builds it. The two must agree character for character. Also bans `#` inside a plural and markup inside a message.

icu/dom.ts — the APPLIED js/dist/forum.js loaded into happy-dom behind a real Flarum-shaped translator, palette driven, Spanish and English text asserted off the rendered DOM, and the DOM scanned for raw keys.
idempotency.py — every replacement is applied / pending / superseded against the live tree, and no entry can be applied twice.
verification.php_intl: Dockerfile:19 installs ext-intl, so the real MessageFormatter is used and not symfony/polyfill-intl-messageformatter, whose own docblock says it implements plural rules for English only.

native_keys.note: Keys added AFTER the i18n migration recorded in `replacements`. They are not find/replace entries because the code that renders them was written i18n-native — there is no pre-patch English literal to match. Recorded here so the map stays a complete account of this extension's strings. es.yml is the SOURCE and en.yml the translation, as everywhere else on this forum.

families.forum.surface.*: The header dropdown / mobile sheet, which did not exist as a distinct component before. close, forget, hint_move, hint_open, hint_close, count.
families.forum.kind.*: The word above a result title saying WHAT it is. discussion|post|user|tag — a closed set fixed by Engine::shape*, so the dynamic suffix cannot miss.
families.forum.landing.*: The /search landing state and the pre-typing dropdown. Both previously rendered `empty.heading` with an empty {query}, i.e. the literal string “No encontramos nada para “””.
families.forum.error.*: The designed error state. heading, status, retry. `results.failed` is still the sentence; these are the frame around it.
families.forum.filters.after|before|phrase|negati: Filter controls and chips that had no UI at all: date range, phrase, negation, sort and type were parsed by QueryParser and shown nowhere.
families.forum.types.label: Accessible name of the type tablist.
families.forum.results.placeholder|pager|page_of: The results input placeholder and the pager, which announced nothing and showed no position.
families.forum.empty.sub|all_types|try_stem|every: Zero-result recovery beyond what Engine::recover returns (measured: it returns [] for a single unknown word).

removed.forum.palette.dialog_label: The palette is no longer a role=dialog; the surface is a combobox popup (dropdown) or a full-screen sheet, neither of which is a modal dialog.
removed.forum.palette.open_full: Superseded by forum.palette.see_all, which is now the single call to action in both the empty and non-empty dropdown.
removed.forum.palette.timing: The dropdown footer shows the suggestion COUNT (forum.surface.count) rather than engine timings; timings stayed on the results page (forum.results.timing) where they are actionable.
